description: Price a rate lock for a future naira payment from the on-chain futures book: the locked rate, premium over today, margin needed, and the order to sign. Prices only; nothing is placed. Needs an API key.

market.description: A futures series such as cNGN-30NOV26; defaults to the nearest

side.description: "buy_usd": dollars needed later (importer, payroll). "sell_usd": dollars received later.

name: lock_rate
title: Lock a naira rate
